MATCH_FINAL.definition: The entire sporting event has concluded across all innings/periods and an official match result has been declared.

MARKET_FINAL.definition: The specific condition, period, innings, or threshold defined by the market contract has reached completion or an irreversible state.

auditVerdict: A Team Total Runs market measures a single innings. When that innings is complete or the line is crossed, the market is contractually and mathematically final regardless of the remaining match state.
